meta.pageTitle: GATE CSE Digital Logic Previous Year Questions – Solved PYQs

questions.text:
Consider the following Boolean expression.

[latex]F=(X+Y+Z)(\overline X +Y)(\overline Y +Z)[/latex]

Which of the following Boolean expressions is/are equivalent to [latex]\overline F[/latex] (complement of [latex]F[/latex])?
questions.solution:
Find where F = 1 (XYZ): X = 1 forces Y = 1 (second factor), Y = 1 forces Z = 1 (third), and 000 fails the first. So [latex]F=\Sigma(1,3,7)[/latex] and [latex]\overline F=\Sigma(0,2,4,5,6)[/latex].

- [latex]X\bar Y+\bar Z[/latex] = {4, 5} [latex]\cup[/latex] {0, 2, 4, 6} = {0, 2, 4, 5, 6} True
- [latex](X+\bar Z)(\bar Y+\bar Z)[/latex] = {0, 2, 4, 5, 6} True
- [latex]X\bar Y+Y\bar Z+\bar X\bar Y\bar Z[/latex] = {4, 5} [latex]\cup[/latex] {2, 6} [latex]\cup[/latex] {0} True
- Option 1 is the dual, not the complement (it contains 1, not 0) False

Answer: Options 2, 3 and 4

questions.text:
Consider a 3-bit counter, designed using T flip-flops, as shown below:

Assuming the initial state of the counter given by PQR as 000, what are the next three states?
questions.solution:
From the circuit: [latex]T_P=R[/latex], [latex]T_Q=\overline P[/latex], [latex]T_R=\overline Q[/latex] (a T flip-flop toggles when T = 1).
- 000: T = (0, 1, 1) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 011
- 011: T = (1, 1, 0) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 101
- 101: T = (1, 0, 1) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 000

Answer: 011, 101, 000

questions.text:
Consider the following representation of a number in IEEE 754 single-precision floating point format with a bias of 127.

S:1
E:10000001
F:11110000000000000000000

Here, S,E and F denote the sign, exponent, and fraction components of the floating point representation.

The decimal value corresponding to the above representation (rounded to 2 decimal places) is ____________.
questions.solution:
Exponent = 129 [latex]-[/latex] 127 = 2. Mantissa = 1.1111[latex]{}_2[/latex] = 1 + 0.5 + 0.25 + 0.125 + 0.0625 = 1.9375. Sign 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] negative.

Value [latex]=-1.9375\times2^2=-7.75[/latex]

Answer: -7.75

questions.text: Let the representation of a number in base 3 be 210. What is the hexadecimal representation of the number?
questions.solution:
[latex](210)_3=2\times9+1\times3+0=21[/latex]
21 = 16 + 5 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex](15)_{16}[/latex]

Answer: 15

questions.text:
A new flipflop with inputs X and Y, has the following property
[latex]\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|} \hline \mathbf{X} & \mathbf{Y} & \text { Current state } & \text { Next state } \\ \hline 0 & 0 & Q & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & Q & \bar{Q} \\ 1 & 1 & Q & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & Q & Q \\ \hline \end{array}[/latex]
Which of the following expresses the next state in terms of X,Y, current state?
questions.solution:
Check [latex](\bar X\wedge\bar Q)\vee(\bar Y\wedge Q)[/latex] against the table:
- XY = 00: [latex]\bar Q\vee Q=1[/latex] True
- XY = 01: [latex]\bar Q\vee0=\bar Q[/latex] True
- XY = 11: 0 True
- XY = 10: [latex]0\vee Q=Q[/latex] True

Answer: [latex](\bar X\wedge\bar Q)\vee(\bar Y\wedge Q)[/latex]
